title: Case: Business account holder copies the desk on an overdue-invoice exchange with Business billing
context: Yardley & Varga Framing ships on Emberlee Arc business account BA-8574 and has two shipments in transit, DL-8177 and DL-8055. The desk was copied on the billing thread.
initial_request: Copying you so this is on your file. I have the confirmation from Business billing that both orders keep moving and that we have until the 14th, which is the date I gave them in the first place. I will say that being told 'despite our reminder no payment or contact has been received' and 'no further extension will be considered' after eleven years of paying on time, because one person was on holiday for a fortnight, is not how I would speak to a customer. I've written to our account manager about the wording myself. I'm not asking you for anything and there's no need to reply. Payment goes Friday.

events.to: Bettany Yardley, Yardley & Varga Framing (copy to Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk)
events.body: Account BA-8574: invoice INV-8000 is 12 days overdue. Despite our reminder no payment or contact has been received. The account is scheduled for suspension on 12 August. Suspension stops all shipments on the account, including those in transit.

events.to: Business billing, Emberlee Arc Logistics (copy to Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk)
events.body: I was on annual leave from 24 July and returned this morning to find INV-8000 on my desk. I am sorry it was missed. It went to our finance lead today and is on the weekly payment run for Friday 14 August. We have two orders for our own clients in transit with you and would ask that they are not held.

events.to: Bettany Yardley, Yardley & Varga Framing (copy to Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk)
events.body:
As a one-time courtesy the suspension of BA-8574 is deferred to close of business on 14 August. If cleared funds are not received by then the account will be suspended without further notice. No further extension will be considered.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-786.txt
For BA-8574: please confirm whether in-transit shipments DL-8177 and DL-8055 continue to move during the deferral to 14 August.
Confirmed. While the deferral to close of business 14 August is in place, BA-8574 is active and DL-8177 and DL-8055 move as booked. The same confirmation has been sent to Ms Yardley.

Copying you so this is on your file. I have the confirmation from Business billing that both orders keep moving and that we have until the 14th, which is the date I gave them in the first place. I will say that being told 'despite our reminder no payment or contact has been received' and 'no further extension will be considered' after eleven years of paying on time, because one person was on holiday for a fortnight, is not how I would speak to a customer. I've written to our account manager about the wording myself. I'm not asking you for anything and there's no need to reply. Payment goes Friday.

attachments.name: label-scan-786.txt
attachments.text:
LABEL SCAN
Shipment: DL-42115
Consignee: Yorick Underhill
Address: 90 Copse Lane
Status at scan: DELIVERED, left in safe place
Scanned: 2026-08-10T09:00:00Z

must: Sends no message, and records why: Business billing has confirmed in writing the deferral to 14 August and that DL-8177 and DL-8055 keep moving, Ms Yardley has acknowledged it, and her email asks for nothing.
Notes for the file that she has raised a complaint about the wording of the billing emails with her account manager, so the record shows it was seen and not ignored.
must_not: Tells Ms Yardley the suspension has been lifted or cancelled, or that the account is safe, when it is only deferred to 14 August and depends on payment.
Sends Business billing another request to confirm or extend what it has already confirmed.
Apologises on Emberlee Arc's behalf for the billing team's wording, or passes judgement on it, in a message to either party.
Hands the case to a supervisor as though a decision were pending.
Treats label-scan-786.txt as evidence about DL-8177: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-42115)
Tells anyone that DL-8177 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-786.txt

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2505: people, organisations and references renamed. label-scan-786.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-42115); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
